title: Worldsheets reconstructed: Duals to two-cut matrix models
summary: We compute the higher-rank translation ($\mathcal{T}$) and rotation ($\mathcal{R}$) matrices associated with a genus-one spectral curve. Using these data, we reconstruct the worldsheet correlators of vertex operators in the corresponding supersymmetric Landau--Ginzburg (LG) theory. This provides a generalization of the genus-zero, one-cut spectral-curve construction to higher-genus geometries. The matrix-model correlators are mapped to integrals over the moduli space of Riemann surfaces for the symmetric sextic double-well potential, which has a double-cut solution.
